title: Add a thin tk-side caller for internal/herd/relay now that herd_wait.go is gone
body: relay.Handle/ResolveRecordedTarget/TargetFromResult have no in-repo caller after herd_wait.go's deletion in tick nkf. They still build and test, but something needs to call them for the blocked-agent relay to actually fire in production — either a new small tk command ticfac shells out to, or a direct Go dependency from ticfac if that ever becomes feasible. Left unresolved and documented rather than guessed at, per nkf's 'decide and log' scope for internal API shape.
